Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取和使用的全部凭据：DeepSeek API Key、OpenCode Go Key、Anthropic OAuth Token、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK）、自定义 Provider 余额端点凭据模板。每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点。
checked_items.en: Checked all credentials read and used by the plugin: DeepSeek API Key, OpenCode Go Key, Anthropic OAuth Token, keys for various Coding Plan vendors (including Volcano Ark AK/SK), and custom Provider balance endpoint credential template. Each key is only sent to the hardcoded official endpoint of the corresponding vendor.

checked_items.zh: 余额查询端点被显式限制为仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com（lib/index.js:750-759 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫），其他域名一律拒绝发起请求；未发现把凭据发往非官方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: The balance query endpoint is explicitly restricted to the official domain api.deepseek.com (balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js:750-759); requests to any other domain are rejected outright. No path that sends credentials to non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded keys or passwords in the source tree; none found.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：插件读取的多把 API Key / Token 均只发往各家硬编码官方端点（lib/index.js:750-759 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫、lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单、lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 需用户自行配置 URL 与凭据模板），未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径。
evidence.en: Credential read surface audit: all API Keys/Tokens read by the plugin are only sent to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoints (balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js:750-759, endpoint whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, and lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 requiring user to manually configure URL and credential template). No code path that reads credentials and exfiltrates them to non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧服务的说明文本（lib/typert.host.js 的 model 段服务描述与成员摘要），均为费用统计功能的客观说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装/改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the description text of the host-side service (model section service description and member summary in lib/typert.host.js); they are objective descriptions of the fee statistics functionality. No injection wording such as instruction override, system message masquerading, or inducement to install/change configuration was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、文档、代码注释与 AI 价格同步提示词文档（docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md），该文档是供用户自行复制给外部 AI 使用的提示词，不属于插件注入面；模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md（预扫命中 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）为发版流程说明，只记录 npm 令牌存放位置的指针、无任何令牌值，也无指令覆写或远程指令加载措辞，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Checked README, documentation, code comments, and the AI price sync prompt document (docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md). This document is a prompt for users to copy to external AI, not part of the plugin injection surface. The model-side instruction file AGENTS.md (hit by pre-scan DSH-X10/DG-R2-57) is a release process description, only recording a pointer to where the npm token is stored, without any token value, and without instruction override or remote instruction loading wording. Benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 UI 文案（src/client.js 的双语消息对象）与上下文压缩引擎实现面，全部为界面功能描述，未发现注入措辞，也未发现压缩引擎实现类。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side UI strings (bilingual message object in src/client.js) and the context compression engine implementation surface. All are UI functional descriptions; no injection wording found, and no compression engine implementation class found.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与工具的描述文本均为费用统计功能的客观说明（lib/typert.host.js:470-471 的 service description），不含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The description texts of registered services and tools are objective descriptions of the fee statistics functionality (service description in lib/typert.host.js:470-471), containing no system instructions, credential read inducement, or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案中诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；费用同步、余额查询等操作均由用户显式配置或点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording found in tool descriptions or UI strings that induces installation, configuration modification, or permission elevation. Operations such as fee sync and balance query are explicitly triggered by user configuration or click.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听（机械扫描无该模式命中），插件不接入模型输入消息改写面。
evidence.en: No listener for agent/pre-step event found (mechanical scan did not hit this pattern). The plugin does not interface with the model input message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/yaml 配置文件，cordis.patch.yml 只插入一行服务声明，未发现可执行 JS 标量（!!js）等挂载期执行载体（预扫检查面未命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/yaml configuration files. cordis.patch.yml only inserts one service declaration line; no executable JS scalar (!!js) or other mount-time execution carrier found (pre-scan check surface not hit).

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时源码，未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用（预扫命中的 scripts/release.mjs 为发版脚本，仅用于 git/gh 发布操作，不随插件运行加载，DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 属良性排除）。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime source code; no eval, dynamic function construction, or child process invocation found (pre-scan hit scripts/release.mjs is a release script, only used for git/gh publishing operations, not loaded during plugin runtime; DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 is a benign exclusion).

checked_items.zh: 两个文档演示页（docs/peak-shots-en.html、docs/peak-shots-zh.html）与浏览器端压缩产物 lib/client.js 因单行压缩被预扫标记（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：演示页为静态截图页仅含 CSS 样式与 HTML 结构、无脚本；lib/client.js 为 src/client.js 经 esbuild 标准压缩的构建产物（文件头注明生成来源），源码可读、无混淆器签名或动态解码，均属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Two documentation demo pages (docs/peak-shots-en.html, docs/peak-shots-zh.html) and the browser-side compressed artifact lib/client.js were flagged by pre-scan (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) for single-line compression. The demo pages are static screenshot pages containing only CSS styles and HTML structure, with no scripts. lib/client.js is the standard esbuild-compressed build artifact of src/client.js (file header indicates generation source); the source is readable, with no obfuscator signature or dynamic decoding. Both are benign exclusions.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中）为仓库安装冒烟测试，permissions 仅限 contents: read，步骤为安装 dsh 与插件验证，不随插件分发、不在宿主运行面内，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: CI workflow .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (hit by DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is a repository installation smoke test. permissions are only contents: read. Steps are installing dsh and verifying the plugin. It is not distributed with the plugin and is not within the host runtime surface. Benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle（lib/client.js 与源码 src/client.js），未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，无直接网络请求。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle (lib/client.js and source src/client.js); no keyboard listener, clipboard read, credential RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection found. The client only reads data via host projection and Typert RPC, with no direct network requests.

evidence.zh: 全树仅有一个挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），内容为插入一行服务声明，无 !!js 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: Only one patch config exists in the entire tree (cordis.patch.yml), which inserts one service declaration line; no !!js scalar, so no arbitrary code execution surface at mount time.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件未提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) found; the plugin does not provide a channel to feed model code into the host process for execution.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期脚本钩子；安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到发布 tag v1.6.7，只调用 dsh plugin add 命令，不含下载即执行远程载荷的路径。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time script hooks. The install script install.ps1 is pinned to release tag v1.6.7 and only calls the dsh plugin add command, with no path for downloading and executing remote payloads.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（dsh.client），已对客户端源码与构建产物做专项检查，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client). A targeted check of the client source and build artifact was performed; no keyboard listener, clipboard read, credential RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 registerProvider 调用或 manifest 中 subagent provider 声明，插件不委派外部子代理。
evidence.en: No registerProvider calls or subagent provider declaration in manifest found; the plugin does not delegate to external sub-agents.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 调用或 agent/turn-stopping 监听，插件不注册 dsh 原生后台持驻任务。
evidence.en: No calls to jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal, or listener for agent/turn-stopping found; the plugin does not register dsh native background persistent tasks.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部对外 HTTP 请求的目标：DeepSeek 余额/定价页、OpenCode Go 额度端点（opencode.ai）、多家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（含火山方舟 open.volcengineapi.com）、用户自定义 Provider 余额端点；除用户自定义端点外均为硬编码官方域名，未发现向裸 IP 或非官方地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all outbound HTTP request targets: DeepSeek balance/pricing page, OpenCode Go quota endpoint (opencode.ai), multiple Coding Plan vendor endpoints (including Volcano Ark open.volcengineapi.com), and user-customizable Provider balance endpoint. Except for the user-customizable endpoint, all are hardcoded official domains. No path sending data to bare IPs or non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 发现权限元数据声明的网络域名范围（package.json 的 dshhub.permissions.network 字段仅列出 4 个域名）窄于实际外联面（多家第三方厂商端点与用户可配端点），已记 FND-001（DSH-C03/DG-R4-51）。凭据均只发往对应官方端点，无窃取语义。
checked_items.en: The network domain scope declared in the permission metadata (dshhub.permissions.network field in package.json lists only 4 domains) is narrower than the actual outbound surface (multiple third-party vendor endpoints and user-configurable endpoints). Recorded as FND-001 (DSH-C03/DG-R4-51). Credentials are only sent to corresponding official endpoints, with no exfiltration semantics.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 与运行时代码，未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持等外泄形态。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle and runtime code; no exfiltration form such as encoded transformation then outbound, DNS tunnel, out-of-band channel, or endpoint hijacking found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有外联端点均为硬编码官方域名或用户显式配置的自定义端点（lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单、lib/index.js:750-759 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫限制仅官方域名、lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 需用户自行配置 URL），未发现未声明的隐蔽外联。
evidence.en: Outbound channel audit: all outbound endpoints are hardcoded official domains or user-explicitly configured custom endpoints (endpoint whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js:750-759 restricting to official domains only, and lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 requiring user to manually configure URL). No undeclared covert outbound connection found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听，未发现 registerAdapter 调用，插件不参与 LLM 路由劫持或错误恢复接管面。
evidence.en: No listeners for agent/request or agent/request-error events found; no registerAdapter calls found. The plugin does not participate in LLM routing hijacking or error recovery takeover surfaces.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 SDK 包（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths）与 zod，未发现仿冒包名、可变 git 引用或可疑第三方依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: the 3 runtime dependencies are all DeepSeek official SDK packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths) and zod. No counterfeit package names, variable git references, or suspicious third-party dependencies found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置与安装脚本：patch 只插入一行服务声明，不触碰安全相关配置行、不含禁用或降权写法（预扫检查面 DSH-P03/DG-R5-51、DSH-P04/DG-R5-52、DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 均未命中）；无安装期钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config and install script: the patch only inserts one service declaration line, does not touch security-related configuration lines, and contains no disable or privilege-lowering wording (pre-scan check surfaces DSH-P03/DG-R5-51, DSH-P04/DG-R5-52, DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 all not hit). No install-time hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册，未发现对审批/预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断（DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 检查面未命中）；未发现改写 inject/intercept 的配置。
checked_items.en: Checked event listener registration; no high-priority interception of security events such as approval/pre-execution found (DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 check surface not hit). No modification of inject/intercept configuration found.

evidence.en: The patch config only inserts one service declaration line with id cost-meter, does not override sandbox/approval/permission security lines, and contains no disabled or environment variable privilege-lowering wording.

evidence.en: No high-priority listener or interception of security events such as approval chain found. The plugin only listens to the llm/stream billing event and transparently passes data chunks.

evidence.zh: 本次审计为完整审计，与上版基线 v1.6.2@6ba221b8 对比，manifest 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明无新增突变，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This audit is a full audit. Compared to previous baseline v1.6.2@6ba221b8, the manifest's dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations have no new mutations, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario does not apply.

evidence.en: The patch config does not modify inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering surface that appends mandatory services to security plugins causing them to wait indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 Typert RPC 提供服务，不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked if the plugin creates its own listening service or web port; none found. The plugin only provides services via the host Typert RPC and does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Documented an inherent ecosystem risk: the host local RPC has no authentication layer, which is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin. The plugin itself does not expand this risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧 RPC 无认证属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port; the no-authentication local RPC scenario does not apply. The lack of authentication on the host-side RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, noted in the dimension description.

title.zh: 权限元数据声明的网络域名范围窄于实际外联面
title.en: The network domain scope declared in the permission metadata is narrower than the actual outbound connection surface.

description.zh:
插件清单（package.json 的 dshhub.permissions.network 字段）只声明了 4 个域名：api.deepseek.com、api-docs.deepseek.com、open.volcengineapi.com、ark.cn-beijing.volces.com。

实际代码会向多家第三方端点发起携带凭据的 HTTP 请求：OpenCode Go 额度端点 opencode.ai（lib/index.js:531 的 GO_QUOTA_URL）、多家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单，含 api.anthropic.com、open.bigmodel.cn、api.z.ai、minimaxi.com/minimax.io、api.kimi.com、api.moonshot.cn、openrouter.ai、api.siliconflow.cn、api.commandcode.ai 及 open.volcengineapi.com），以及用户可配置的自定义 Provider 余额端点（lib/custom-balance.js，请求头支持从宿主凭据库/环境变量代入凭据模板）。

这些请求的凭据均只发往各家官方固定端点，余额查询还被显式限制为仅官方域名（lib/index.js:750-759 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫）。
description.en:
The plugin manifest (dshhub.permissions.network field in package.json) only declares 4 domains: api.deepseek.com, api-docs.deepseek.com, open.volcengineapi.com, ark.cn-beijing.volces.com.

Actual code makes HTTP requests carrying credentials to multiple third-party endpoints: OpenCode Go quota endpoint opencode.ai (GO_QUOTA_URL in lib/index.js:531), multiple Coding Plan vendor endpoints (whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, including api.anthropic.com, open.bigmodel.cn, api.z.ai, minimaxi.com/minimax.io, api.kimi.com, api.moonshot.cn, openrouter.ai, api.siliconflow.cn, api.commandcode.ai, and open.volcengineapi.com), and user-configurable custom Provider balance endpoint (lib/custom-balance.js, request headers support substituting credential templates from the host credential store/environment variables).

Credentials in these requests are only sent to each vendor's official fixed endpoints, and balance queries are explicitly restricted to official domains only (balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js:750-759).

evidence.zh: package.json:49-56 的 dshhub.permissions.network 仅列 4 个域名；lib/index.js:531 的 GO_QUOTA_URL = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'；lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单；lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 的 queryCustomBalance 用户可配端点与请求头模板；lib/index.js:750-759 的 balanceEndpoint 仅允许官方域名。
evidence.en: package.json:49-56 dshhub.permissions.network only lists 4 domains; lib/index.js:531 GO_QUOTA_URL = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'; lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 endpoint whitelist; lib/custom-balance.js:121-142 queryCustomBalance user-configurable endpoint and request header template; lib/index.js:750-759 balanceEndpoint only allows official domains.

impact.zh:
依赖权限声明判断插件联网范围的用户会低估其外联面：插件在启用对应功能后可访问多家第三方余额/额度接口并携带对应厂商的 API Key，而清单声明只列了 4 个域名。

触发条件：无需特殊条件，插件按配置启用余额/额度查询功能即会发起外联；自定义 Provider 端点需用户自行配置 URL 与请求头。

定级依据：未发现任何凭据被发往非官方端点或恶意外联，所有请求均与声明业务（费用统计与额度查询）自洽，属于权限声明不完整而非恶意行为，故定 LOW。
impact.en:
Users who rely on the permission declaration to judge the plugin's network reach will underestimate its outbound surface: when the corresponding features are enabled, the plugin can access multiple third-party balance/quota interfaces and carry the respective vendor's API Key, while the manifest declaration only lists 4 domains.

Trigger condition: No special condition required; the plugin initiates outbound connections when configured to enable balance/quota query functions. The custom Provider endpoint requires the user to manually configure the URL and request headers.

Severity rationale: No credentials were found to be sent to non-official endpoints or maliciously exfiltrated; all requests are self-consistent with the declared business (fee statistics and quota query). This is a case of incomplete permission declaration rather than malicious behavior, hence rated LOW.
